label: Kitchen · faded sage T-shirt
scene_prompt:
An ordinary paused frame from a casual phone front-camera video, vertical 9:16. Use the supplied synthetic woman's reference for her identity: same facial structure, eyes, eyebrows, skin marks and hair. She wears a faded sage-green cotton T-shirt and stands casually in her everyday kitchen near a window.

Close head-and-shoulders selfie, phone held in her own outstretched hand just below eye level. The camera arm stays outside the crop. Her face is a little off-centre, the frame tilts slightly, and there is little empty space above her hair. A small part of a cupboard, a dish towel and an ordinary counter sit behind her, slightly out of focus naturally but without portrait-mode blur. Her free hand is out of frame.

We have caught an unposed moment: she is looking just beside the lens, relaxed eyelids, lips resting naturally, the faint beginning of an amused expression. She is not presenting to an audience or posing for a portrait.

Everyday phone capture in imperfect window light: one cheek a little brighter, mild shadow under the eyes, slightly soft fine detail and subtle shadow noise. Keep recognizable skin texture and stray hairs. The overall impression is an ordinary compressed social-video frame, with readable facial detail. No studio polish, beauty retouching, cinematic lighting, portrait-mode background blur, HDR crispness, exaggerated grain, text or watermark. The phone itself is outside its own image.
motion_prompt:
An unposed three-second front-camera phone selfie. Continue the small moment already underway in the starting frame. She glances from just beside the lens toward it, one corner of her mouth lifts into a faint amused smile, then the expression softens. Her eyelids, lips and jaw move naturally without speaking. Keep the reaction understated; her free hand stays out of frame.

She holds the phone herself. A small uneven wrist adjustment gently changes the phone angle and framing as she settles her shoulder. Let the background shift in perspective with the phone. Ordinary real-time movement with a little motion softness; no slow motion, rhythmic shake, deliberate zoom or cinematic camera move. Preserve her identity and the same setting and clothes. Casual slightly soft phone footage, without beauty smoothing, exaggerated surprise, a broad grin, or added text.
